metadata.scope: Synthetic projected attention adapter; projections, norms, cache writes, native indexer and selection, attention. No output projection, model MLP, communication, planning, compilation, allocation, or scheduler.
metadata.prefill: Final chunk, 2048 total query tokens (unless overridden); eager. Not TTFT.
metadata.decode: One query per request; CUDA graph replay; L2 flush outside each sample.
metadata.architecture_details: Absorbed MLA 512+64, BF16 KV, 64Q/1KV 128-dim FP8 production indexer; 64-token pages; 48 main heads padded to 64 for FlashMLA; dense FlashInfer MLA FA2 and FA3.
